_readme: Curated overview data for admin/repo-map.html — the branch/workflow inventory.
This file supplies the 'why' a GitHub API call cannot answer: category, purpose,
and a recommendation per branch and workflow. The page overlays this with LIVE
data (ahead/behind, last run, last commit) fetched from the GitHub API at view time.
'category' for workflows: content-import | enrichment | ocr | search-index |
Hand-maintained. Update when a branch/workflow's role changes — this is not
Analysis date: 2026-09-05. Verified via: git merge-base --is-ancestor (ancestry),
git diff --stat against origin/main (content overlap), and the GitHub PR list

snapshot.* on each branch = git-verified data as of the analysis date above (ahead/behind vs main, ancestry, last commit). Baked in so the page shows real numbers with zero GitHub API calls; a per-branch 'Refresh live' button re-checks on demand.

inputs.name: source_repo

inputs.name: source_dir

inputs.name: source_ref

ask-claude.yml.display_name: Ask Claude — live replies to the website inbox
ask-claude.yml.purpose: Runs a Claude Code session on GitHub's runner whenever the Ask Claude tab commits a request into tasks/inbox/. Claude reads the request, answers or makes the change (changes go to a branch and a pull request, never straight to main), and commits its reply into the same file, which the page is polling.
ask-claude.yml.notes: Needs one repository secret: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (console.anthropic.com) or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (`claude setup-token` on a subscription). Spends Anthropic credits, never Gemini. Skips its own reply commits so it cannot loop.
ask-claude.yml.reason: The live half of Ask Claude; without it replies wait for Sunday.

generated.name: Ask Claude — answer inbox requests

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: Inbox id to answer (blank = every request whose status is pending)

writes: commits directly to the branch it ran on

schedule.ist: 3:00 am IST on the 1+1st of every month

inputs.name: paths
inputs.label: data/ prefixes to build padaccheda for (comma-separated)

inputs.name: sandhi
inputs.label: Also rebuild the sandhi indexes (slow)

inputs.name: groups
inputs.label: Groups to delete (verified, superseded, decide), comma-separated

inputs.name: confirm
inputs.label: Type DELETE to allow deletion

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.label: List only, delete nothing

darshanas.yml.purpose: Builds the Nyāya / Mīmāṃsā / Vaiśeṣika folder tree from tools/darshanas/darshana_works.json and pulls a chosen text from GRETIL or sanskritdocuments.org into it. Opens a pull request.
darshanas.yml.reason: The only importer for the six-darśana branch.

inputs.name: action
inputs.label: What to run

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: GRETIL text id to ingest (see tools/darshanas/README.md, or run --list)

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.label: Report only — write nothing

inputs.name: open_pr
inputs.label: Open a pull request with the results (requires dry_run = false)

deploy-firebase-functions.yml.purpose: Deploys firebase/functions (OTP, WhatsApp, donations, and the listWorkflows/runWorkflow pair that makes the Run buttons on this page work without a token in the browser).
deploy-firebase-functions.yml.notes: Blocked until push-firebase-function-secrets has run once — every declared secret needs a version before any function deploys.
deploy-firebase-functions.yml.reason: Required for accounts, payments and one-click workflow runs.

inputs.name: only
inputs.label: Optional: a specific function or comma list (e.g. "requestOtp,verifyOtp"). Leave blank to deploy all functions.

inputs.name: corpus_bucket
inputs.label: Authenticated corpus proxy: the PRIVATE GCS bucket holding the corpus (e.g. sarvamula-corpus). Blank leaves corpusFile switched off — it answers 503 and the reader keeps using static files. Upload with tools/migrate_corpus_to_gcs.py first.

inputs.name: corpus_prefix
inputs.label: Object-name prefix inside that bucket. Must match the --prefix the migration script used.

inputs.name: corpus_config_url
inputs.label: Where corpusFile reads the live shelf from (usually https://<project>.web.app/admin/config/library-overrides.json). Blank falls back to the copy bundled at deploy time, below.

inputs.name: install_pdf_renderer
inputs.label: Install puppeteer so renderBook can return real PDFs. Adds ~170 MB to the image and a few minutes to the build; leave off and renderBook answers 503 while every other function deploys normally.

inputs.name: payment_gateway
inputs.label: Default payment gateway for this deployment. mock is EMULATOR-ONLY — a deployed mock refuses every donation by design.

inputs.name: payment_gateways_enabled

workflow_categories.label: 🌐 Online source syncers
workflow_categories.blurb: One card per outside website we take text from. Each asks the site whether anything changed since last time and reports; none of them imports on its own.

workflow_categories.label: 📥 Importers — bring text in
workflow_categories.blurb: Fetch a corpus from its source and open a pull request (or republish a dist branch). These rewrite what readers see, so they are run by hand and reviewed.

workflow_categories.label: ✨ Gemini enrichment — costs money
workflow_categories.blurb: Send text to Gemini for padaccheda, anvaya, summaries, reference resolution or dhātu meanings. Every run spends prepaid credits: estimate first (CLAUDE.md rule).

workflow_categories.label: 🔎 OCR — scanned books to text
workflow_categories.blurb: Turn PDF page scans into staged JSON with Google Vision (₹) and, where the pipeline says so, a Gemini proofread (₹). Staged, never merged automatically.

workflow_categories.label: 🔍 Search index & cross-links
workflow_categories.blurb: Rebuild the things derived from the corpus: the search index, backlinks, sūtra/dhātu occurrence indexes, trackers, library status, the WordNet.

workflow_categories.label: 🚀 Deploy & infrastructure
workflow_categories.blurb: Firebase Hosting/Functions/Firestore deploys, the SEO page build, and secret pushes. Nothing here changes corpus data.

workflow_categories.label: 🐄 Kamadhenu voice (TTS) experiments
workflow_categories.blurb: The IndicF5 fine-tuning programme on Hugging Face: Space deploys, diagnostics, log readers, and the one paid training job. Dated experiment scaffolding.

workflow_categories.label: ✅ Tests
workflow_categories.blurb: Runs on every push and pull request. Never delete.

workflow_categories.label: 🧪 One-off probes — kept as a record
workflow_categories.blurb: Diagnostics that answered a question once (is this site reachable, is this scan alignable). They write nothing. Safe to delete; git history keeps them.

workflow_categories.label: ❓ Not yet classified
workflow_categories.blurb: New workflow files this script found with no manifest entry. Give each a category, purpose and recommendation in admin/config/repo-map.json.
